official.deadline_note: The Round 7 (Semester 2, 2026) window closed at 3:00 PM (AWST) on Friday, 29 May 2026. The Department states 'Please check back soon for updates on when applications for Semester 1, 2027 will open' and publishes no Semester 1 2027 dates.
official.application_cycle: Semester-based rounds. Round 7 was for Semester 2, 2026 enrolments (9:00am 3 March 2026 to 3:00pm 29 May 2026); Round 8 for Semester 1, 2027 enrolments is not yet open.
official.status_note: The last round closed on 29 May 2026 and the Government page, last updated 4 March 2026, says to check back for updates on when Semester 1, 2027 applications open. The WA Premier's WACE Scholarship is currently open on a rolling basis.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The $50,000 is a scholarship 'towards their course fees and other university costs' at one of Western Australia's five universities - it is not a fee waiver and the University decides the frequency and value of the credit.
official.funding_period: one-off, towards course fees and other university costs
benefits: $50,000 scholarship towards course fees and other university costs
Ten scholarships awarded per year, two at each of Western Australia's five universities
eligibility: Be a new offshore enrolment into an undergraduate or postgraduate course at one of Western Australia's five universities

Be a citizen of a listed eligible country: Bangladesh, Bhutan, Brazil, China, Colombia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Japan, Kenya, Malaysia, Nepal, Oman, Republic of Korea (South Korea), Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Sri Lanka, the Philippines, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom or Vietnam
Meet the eligibility criteria published in the application form on the chosen university's website
Not be a domestic student or an onshore international student
requirements: Choose one of Western Australia's five universities and apply directly through that university's official website
Meet the eligibility criteria published by the chosen university
Submit the university application within that university's scholarship window, which opens with the round
documents: Academic records, as assessed by the chosen university
Responses to qualitative questions contained in the university's application
Supporting documents specified by the chosen university
selection_criteria: Demonstration of a high level of academic achievement as determined by the admitting university
Individual universities may require additional qualitative assessment through written or interview responses to short-listed applicants
coverage: $50,000 towards course fees and other university costs, applied against the recipient's fee and tuition account at the enrolling university
application_method: Choose a participating Western Australian university
official.application_route: Apply directly to one of Western Australia's five universities during its published scholarship window - the Government does not accept applications itself.
official.study_mode: Undergraduate or postgraduate coursework at one of Western Australia's five universities
official.citizenship_residency: New offshore international students only; citizens of the 22 listed eligible countries
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scheme exists only for new offshore international students from the listed countries; domestic students and onshore international students are not eligible
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Open to undergraduate or postgraduate courses at Curtin University, Edith Cowan University, Murdoch University, the University of Notre Dame Australia (Fremantle) or the University of Western Australia
official.duration: One year of funding, credited against the recipient's fee and tuition account after the University census date for the semester applied for
official.description: The Government of Western Australia states the scholarship 'provides 10 successful students with a $50,000 scholarship towards their course fees and other university costs' and is 'for high-performing international students to each of Western Australia's 5 universities', awarded to 2 successful international students at each of the 5 universities each year to 2026.
official.program_type: State government scholarship, administered by the participating universities

not_confirmed: Semester 1, 2027 round opening and closing dates - not yet published
english_requirement - no Government-level English requirement is published; criteria are set by each chosen university
living_cost_coverage and travel_coverage - the award is described only as being towards course fees and other university costs
verification.notes: The $50,000 value, ten awards across five universities, offshore-only rule, eligible country list and the 29 May 2026 closing date were read from the Government of Western Australia's own programme page, last updated 4 March 2026.

applicant_utility.summary: Nothing happens until one of the five participating universities opens its own window, so the practical task is monitoring those five university websites rather than the Government page. You must be offshore to apply - an international student already studying in Australia cannot use this route. Because only two places exist per university per year and each university sets its own additional criteria, treat the choice of university as the single most consequential decision in the whole application.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving students from the 22 listed countries who are still offshore and can choose which Western Australian university to apply to.
application_readiness_checklist: Decide which of the five universities you will apply to before the round opens, since you apply through that university alone
Watch Curtin, ECU, Murdoch, Notre Dame and UWA scholarship pages for the Semester 1 2027 window to be announced
Prepare academic records and short written responses in advance, because university windows can be short
Be ready for a possible interview if you are short-listed by the university
common_rejection_risks: Assuming you apply to the Government rather than to the university, and missing the university's own window entirely
Being already onshore in Australia, which makes you ineligible regardless of academic standing
Holding citizenship of a country that is not on the 22-country list
Holding another Western Australian Government scholarship, which disqualifies you
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs, accommodation, flights and any course fees beyond the $50,000 credit, which is applied for one year only.
document_audit: The university's own application form, not the Government page, sets the documents - so confirm requirements with the university you have chosen
If you previously held a University, State or Commonwealth scholarship that prohibits multiple scholarships, be prepared to decline it
Payments are exclusive of GST and the University decides the frequency and value of the credit towards course fees
alerts: Only two scholarships are available per university per year, making this one of the most competitive state schemes in Australia
The programme is stated to run 'each year to 2026', so confirm the scheme is continuing before planning around it
The credit is applied after the University census date for the semester applied for, so it will not cover your initial arrival costs
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply to a chosen Western Australian university during its scholarship window, the university assesses and selects recipients, and it informs the Department.

official.deadline_note: CDU publishes closing dates per intake: 31 January 2027 for Semester 1, 2027 and 4 July 2027 for Semester 2, 2027. CDU does not publish a separate opening date for the scholarship.
official.status_note: Applications were open at the time of checking on 1 October 2026; CDU publishes the two 2027 closing dates above but no opening date.
official.tuition_coverage_note: 'The scholarship applies to an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree covering 50% of the tuition fee for the full duration of the course.'
benefits: 50% of the tuition fee for an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree, for the full duration of the course
Results are announced during Orientation Week, earlier than the start of teaching
The scholarship is neither transferable for cash nor refundable and cannot be transferred to another person, semester, course or year
eligibility: Applicant must apply to commence study in Semester 1 or Semester 2 2027 (the intake they are offered first)
Applicant must meet the University's academic and English language entry requirements for their chosen course
Applicant must have a minimum overall score of 95% in their highest completed qualification
Applicant must be an international student paying international student fees
Applicant must not hold another scholarship from an Australian or foreign sponsoring agency
requirements: Step 1: apply to study at CDU
Step 2: submit your application for the VCIHAS
Applicants must be able to pay their portion of the tuition fees on or before the payment due date, which CDU states is the first day of teaching of each semester

Ongoing eligibility: continue to be an international student liable for international student fees, maintain satisfactory academic progress each semester with a minimum GPA of 5.3 and no fail grade in any unit, and maintain a full-time enrolment of 40 credit points (0.5 EFTSL) each semester unless approved to reduce
documents: Application intake selection and Application Number (StudyLink or SATAC)
Email address matching the one provided in your Studylink application
Average overall score in your highest completed qualification, provided as a percentage
Applicant statement answering the four published questions
selection_criteria: Overall score in their highest completed qualification
Supporting statements (up to 600 words) outlining why you should be awarded a scholarship
coverage: 50% of the tuition fee for an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree, for the full duration of the course
application_method: Apply to study at CDU and obtain an Application Number (StudyLink or SATAC)
Use the same email address in the scholarship form as in your Studylink application

Complete the Vice-Chancellor's High Achievers Scholarship (VCIHAS) Application form on CDU's website, including your intended intake, your average overall score as a percentage, and the four applicant statement questions
Tick the declaration, sign the form and enter the date
Submit the form before the closing date for your intake
official.application_route: Apply to study at CDU first, then complete and submit the VCIHAS application form with the same email address as your Studylink application.
official.study_mode: Full-time enrolment of 40 credit points (0.5 EFTSL) each semester is required to retain the scholarship
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants must be international students paying international student fees
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scholarship is only for international students paying international student fees
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Applies to an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree; applicants cannot hold more than one tuition fee scholarship from CDU at a time
official.duration: The minimum time in which the course can be completed, or when the maximum scholarship value has been exhausted, the course is completed, or the recipient no longer meets the ongoing eligibility
official.description: CDU states it 'offers a limited number of scholarships for international students who have a record of academic excellence and high achievement', covering 50% of the tuition fee for the full duration of an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree.
official.program_type: University scholarship for international students with a record of academic excellence and high achievement
official.english_requirement: Applicant must meet the University's academic and English language entry requirements for their chosen course; CDU requires all higher education applicants to satisfy the English Language Proficiency Requirements and supply evidence at the time of application.

not_confirmed: funding_amount, funding_currency and funding_period - CDU publishes only a 50% tuition fee percentage and no dollar figure, so no amount can be recorded
living_cost_coverage and travel_coverage - CDU publishes nothing about living costs, relocation or travel support
an opening date for the scholarship, and any interview requirement for VCIHAS specifically (other CDU International College scholarships on the same page do publish an interview requirement)
deferral, return-home, clinical restriction, tax treatment and award renewal terms
verification.notes: The 50% tuition fee coverage, 95% eligibility threshold, 2027 intake condition, selection criteria, ongoing GPA 5.3 and 0.5 EFTSL requirements, the two closing dates and the four statement questions were read from CDU's own international scholarships page and the VCIHAS application form.

applicant_utility.summary: Half the tuition is still half the tuition: you must be able to pay the remaining 50% by the first day of teaching each semester, so this award only helps if you can genuinely fund the rest. Holding the scholarship is a continuing obligation, not a one-off - a GPA below 5.3, a single fail grade, or dropping below 40 credit points in a semester all end it. Note that CDU's own pages disagree on the statement length, with the scholarships page saying up to 600 words and the application form saying 500 words or less, so aim for 500 and stay safe.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International applicants with a 95% or higher overall score in their highest completed qualification who can independently fund the other half of their CDU tuition.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your overall score in your highest completed qualification is at least 95% before investing time in the statement
Apply to study at CDU first and record your StudyLink or SATAC Application Number
Use exactly the same email address in the scholarship form as in your Studylink application
Draft a supporting statement of 500 words or less answering all four published questions
Prepare to pay the remaining 50% of tuition by the first day of teaching of each semester
common_rejection_risks: Holding another scholarship from an Australian or foreign sponsoring agency, which disqualifies you outright
Holding more than one CDU tuition fee scholarship at the same time
Falling below a 5.3 GPA or recording a fail grade in any unit after the award
Dropping below a full-time enrolment of 40 credit points (0.5 EFTSL) in a semester without approval
Using a different email address in the scholarship form than in the Studylink application
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining 50% of tuition fees, plus all living costs, accommodation and health cover in Darwin - the award touches fees only.
document_audit: The application form requires an intake selection, Application Number, matching email, percentage score, statement, declaration, signature and date - an unsigned or undated form is incomplete
The scholarship is neither transferable for cash nor refundable and cannot move between people, semesters, courses or years
The declaration commits you to potentially providing a student story or testimonial as a recipient
alerts: The award ends at the earliest of course completion, exhaustion of the maximum scholarship value, or loss of ongoing eligibility - it is not guaranteed for the minimum course duration
Results are announced during Orientation Week, which is later than most university scholarship timelines

CDU's automatic no-application awards, the CDU Global Merit Scholarship at 30% and the CDU Bachelor of Nursing Scholarship at up to 20%, are assessed after your course application - but you can hold only one CDU tuition fee scholarship at a time
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply to study at CDU, complete and submit the VCIHAS application form with the matching email address and signed declaration, then await the result announced during Orientation Week.
